notes: Per-item size is set by the game developer, not by Valve, and some games are explicitly unlimited. Arma 3: 'Arma 3 Workshop now support items of unlimited size.' Others are tiny: House Flipper raised its cap from 12 MB to 20 MB in a patch. So the quota is per-app, and the number of published items per account is not documented as capped.

extras.egress_verbatim: Free and CDN-served by Valve's content network — same infrastructure as game downloads, genuinely unmetered.
extras.chaining_verbatim: One Steam account x every Workshop-enabled game it owns x unlimited items per game. This is the multiplier: 'unlimited items per published file ID' inside an app whose developer set no cap.
